name: Westfield Culver City
description: Westfield Culver City is a premier shopping destination featuring iconic global brands and exceptional dining experiences in one of Los Angeles' most vibrant neighborhoods. The center offers a dynamic blend of fashion, entertainment, and culinary offerings with state-of-the-art amenities including click-and-collect services and Smart Parking technology. As part of Westfield's global portfolio, this location delivers world-class retail alongside engaging community events and experiences.
demographics: Westfield Culver City attracts an affluent, diverse demographic primarily consisting of professionals and families aged 25-54 with above-average household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The trade area draws from surrounding affluent neighborhoods including Culver City, West Los Angeles, Marina del Rey, and Playa Vista, with visitors seeking a mix of premium retail, entertainment, and dining options. Shoppers demonstrate preferences for both contemporary fashion brands and experiential retail, with strong weekday traffic from nearby tech and entertainment industry professionals and weekend family visits for dining and entertainment.
